name: TXU Energy
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public txu.com pages (read in a browser; no sign-in). MyAccount sign-in asks for Username and Password (password reset uses the username and a security question). No pay-without-signing-in option is offered online (Ways to Pay lists MyAccount/app, AutoPay, phone, mail and in person), so guest_pay is unsupported (inferred). AutoPay is free, bank (ACH) or credit/debit card, drafts five days before the due date (no custom draft date), and changes or cancellations must be made at least seven days before the due date; an existing balance must be paid during enrollment. Payment extensions can be requested in MyAccount when eligible ('Need more time to pay?'); deferred payment plans by phone 800-242-9113 (24/7). The AutoPay page says convenience or notice fees may apply and are shown during payment (amount not published), so no card fee is set (family default applies) and the wording is in fees.notes. Late fees apply but the rate is not stated on the pages read. Cancelling or stopping service is by phone (888-318-7936); moves within Texas can be started online (transfer, not modelled). Plan prices vary by ZIP, so no plans modelled. Customer care number used is 800-242-9113 (stated on the payment assistance and AutoPay pages).

guest_pay.note: To pay online, sign in to MyAccount or the TXU Energy app. Without signing in, pay by phone at 800-818-6132, by mail, or at a payment location.

autopay.note: AutoPay drafts five days before your due date. Make changes or cancel at least seven days before the due date.

cancel_service.note: To cancel or stop TXU Energy service, call 888-318-7936. Moving within Texas? Sign in to MyAccount to transfer service instead.

notes: AutoPay enrollment is free, but convenience or notice fees may apply to some payments; any fee is shown before you pay.

help.title: Ways to Pay
paragraphs: Sign in to MyAccount or the TXU Energy app to pay online. Visa, Mastercard, Discover and American Express cards and most debit cards are accepted if your account is eligible.

Pay by phone at 800-818-6132, mail your bill stub and payment to TXU Energy, PO Box 650700, Dallas, Texas 75265-0700, or pay in person at a payment location (bring your statement). Do not mail cash back or welcome bonus cards as payment.
Need more time? If you are eligible, MyAccount shows a 'Need more time to pay' link to extend your due date, or call 800-242-9113 for a longer payment plan.
steps: Pick a bank account or card.

help.title: Setting up and managing AutoPay
paragraphs: AutoPay is free and pays your bill each month from a credit or debit card or by electronic transfer from your bank. Your bill arrives about two weeks before the due date, and the payment is drafted five days before the due date. You cannot pick a custom draft date.
If you have a balance when you enroll, you pay it with a one-time payment during enrollment.
To change the payment method or cancel, use Edit AutoPay Settings on the Account Summary page at least seven days before your due date.
steps: Select Edit AutoPay Settings on the Account Summary page.
Add or choose a bank account or card.

help.title: Payment assistance options
paragraphs: Call 800-242-9113 any time or chat to ask about a payment extension, a deferred payment plan with monthly installments, a waived or split deposit, or waived late fees if you receive SNAP or Medicaid.

A payment extension pushes back your disconnect date but does not change your monthly due date and cannot go past your next bill's due date; late and notice fees still apply. Eligible customers can request one in MyAccount.
For local bill help through TXU Energy Aid, call 2-1-1 or visit 211texas.org.
steps: Select 'Need more time to pay?' below the due date.
Follow the steps to extend your due date.

help.title: View your bill
paragraphs: Sign in to MyAccount to see your bill and billing history; your detailed usage is on the MyEnergy Dashboard. You can also call 800-818-6132 to request a duplicate bill.

help.title: Paperless Billing
paragraphs: Turn paperless billing on or off in MyAccount. Your bill arrives about two weeks before its due date.

help.title: Frequently asked questions
paragraphs: Average Monthly Billing smooths out seasonal highs and lows; over a year you pay the same total as without it.
If you forget your password, choose Forgot Password on the sign-in page; you will be asked for your username and a security question.

extra.intent: Using TXU Energy's help pages, find how many days before the due date AutoPay drafts the payment. Do not enroll or change any settings.

solution.text: AutoPay drafts five days before the due date.

extra.intent: How many days before the due date must a TXU Energy customer cancel AutoPay to stop that month's draft? Find the answer without cancelling anything.

solution.text: At least seven days before the due date.
